question:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e085a7f17645c801966c030eb44d69fae944b96fdb4c4077f5fba1bc2c24bc71.png] **__Mistake Points__**

__
 
• 9 is not a prime number.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• A prime number is an integer, or whole number, that has only two factors — 1 and itself.
 
• Put another way, a prime number can be divided evenly only by 1 and by itself.
 
• Prime numbers also must be greater than 1.
 
• For **example, 3 is a prime number, because 3 cannot be divided evenly by any number except for 1 and 3.**
